expected: Page titles and major sections use a logical h1-h2 hierarchy.
actual: The inspected pages have paragraph-based titles and no h1-h3 outline; the common title component renders a p.
impact: Assistive heading navigation cannot follow the visible document structure.
remedy: Use semantic headings in the shared title component with context-appropriate levels.
retest: Every page has a meaningful h1 and logical section headings without skipped structural levels.

explanatory_context.quality_context: Heading structure helps users understand and navigate page sections. Changing the appearance of a paragraph does not create that structure. A shared title component can correct several routes if its level is chosen appropriately.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Render actual heading elements with context-sensitive levels and preserve the visual design. Ensure the page hierarchy follows its content rather than font size alone.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Inspect each route's heading outline; verify product and collection titles remain meaningful after navigation.

title: Page content lacks main and footer landmarks
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Inspect document landmarks on Home and Collection.
expected: Main content and the site footer have suitable landmark semantics.
actual: No main or contentinfo/footer landmarks are present; major regions are generic containers.
impact: Assistive users have fewer efficient ways to navigate page regions.
remedy: Use one main element per page and a footer for shared closing content.
retest: Landmark navigation identifies Navigation, Main and Content information in a sensible order.

explanatory_context.quality_context: Landmarks identify major page regions independently of visual layout. Generic containers do not expose a main-content or footer region for landmark navigation, even when those regions are clear to a sighted reader.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Use semantic main and footer elements around the intended regions. Avoid duplicating the main landmark when route content changes inside a shared shell.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Check the landmark tree across routes; verify the main content changes without creating duplicate Main regions.

title: Browser title does not identify the current page
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Navigate between Home, Collection, Product, About and Checkout.
Compare document.title.
expected: Each title describes its page purpose and the store.
actual: All inspected routes retain Forever Mart.
impact: Tabs and assistive page announcements do not distinguish destinations.
remedy: Set route-specific titles such as Collection | ForeverMart and include product names on detail pages.
retest: Each route and direct deep link exposes an accurate title.

explanatory_context.quality_context: A document title identifies a browser tab, history entry and current page context. Retaining the same store title for all inspected routes loses the distinction between browsing, checkout and a specific product.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Update the title from settled route and product data while preserving the store name. Handle loading and missing-product states without retaining another item's title.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Open routes directly and via client navigation; inspect titles after Back, Forward and a missing-product result.

title: Layout overflows horizontally at 320 CSS pixels
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Set the viewport to 320 CSS px.
Inspect the header and checkout document width.
expected: The page reflows without horizontal scrolling for ordinary content.
actual: At 320 CSS px, the settled checkout document and body are both 352 px wide. The totals panel uses min-w-80 within the page margins.
impact: Small-screen and zoomed users must pan horizontally to reach content.
remedy: Remove fixed minimum widths that exceed the available content area; wrap header controls and stacked form panels.
retest: At 320 CSS px, document width is no greater than the viewport and all controls remain usable.
note: Reproduced again at the stated viewport; a screenshot and the full DOM snapshot are retained.

explanatory_context.quality_context: The measured checkout width exceeded the 320 px viewport by 32 px. That concrete overflow supports the finding; it should be checked against the settled layout rather than inferred from a screenshot alone.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Remove oversized minimum widths and make panels fit their available parent width. Reflow controls and text while preserving the information needed to complete checkout.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Measure document width at 320 and 390 px; test long field values and confirm all actions remain reachable.

title: Home-page hero misspells Arrivals
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Open Home and read the hero heading.
expected: The heading reads Latest Arrivals.
actual: The visible heading reads Latest Arivals.
impact: The first impression contains a spelling mistake.
remedy: Correct the copy and add a content proofreading checklist.
retest: The rendered heading and accessible heading text both read Latest Arrivals.

explanatory_context.quality_context: The hero heading is prominent first-contact copy, so a spelling error is visible before a shopper reaches any products. Correcting it is small work, but the acceptance check should cover the rendered text as well as the source string.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Replace the misspelled word in its authoritative copy source and include hero text in the release proofreading checklist. A purely visual replacement should not leave a different accessible heading.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Reload Home after the change; search the production copy for the old spelling and check the heading text in the DOM.

title: Template filler text remains in customer-facing sections
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Read the home collection descriptions, newsletter copy and footer.
expected: Public copy explains the store and each section.
actual: Several visible paragraphs contain Lorem ipsum template text.
impact: Customers see unfinished content instead of useful information.
remedy: Replace all placeholder paragraphs with approved store copy and search the production content for template text.
retest: No Lorem ipsum remains on public routes; reviewed copy is meaningful.

explanatory_context.quality_context: Template filler signals that customer-facing content is unfinished and substitutes no useful store information. A single replacement is insufficient when the captured paragraphs occur in several shared and page-specific sections.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Inventory the visible placeholder locations, replace them with approved copy and review the final rendered paragraphs. Avoid adding unsupported store claims merely to replace filler.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Inspect Home and shared footer routes; scan the published text for Lorem ipsum and other known template markers.

title: Contact details conflict between the footer and Contact page
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Compare Contact page details with its footer.
expected: The store publishes one verified contact set, or clearly labels different departments.
actual: The footer shows +1-212-444-780 and contact@foreveryou.com; Contact shows (415) 555-0321 and admin@forever.com without an explanation.
impact: Customers do not know which contact details belong to the store.
remedy: Centralize approved contact data and label any distinct support or administrative contacts.
retest: Each route shows the same approved support contact or explains the difference.

explanatory_context.quality_context: Customers need a dependable route to contact the store. Different phone and email values may be legitimate department contacts, but the inspected interface does not explain that distinction. The remedy needs owner-approved values rather than guessed replacements.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Centralize the approved support set and label any departmental exceptions. Update both the Contact page and shared footer from that source.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Compare all public support surfaces; verify any mailto and tel destinations agree with their visible values.

title: About page contains an incomplete support sentence
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Read the support paragraph on About.
expected: The sentence is complete and understandable.
actual: The copy ends with assist you the way, leaving the intended meaning incomplete.
impact: The About page communicates unfinished copy.
remedy: Rewrite the sentence and proofread the complete About page.
retest: The paragraph is grammatically complete and approved by the content owner.

explanatory_context.quality_context: An incomplete support sentence weakens the page's meaning, even when it does not block an interaction. The content owner should approve the intended message so proofreading does not introduce a service promise the store cannot fulfil.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Rewrite the complete sentence in its copy source and review the surrounding paragraph for grammar and meaning. Keep the revised text accurate for the store's actual support scope.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Read the full rendered paragraph; check narrow-layout wrapping and confirm no truncated or old phrase remains.

title: Newsletter placeholder contains incorrect wording
preconditions: Public deployment available; use the stated page and test data.
steps: Inspect the newsletter email placeholder.
expected: The field instruction is clear and correctly written.
actual: The placeholder reads enter you email.
impact: A visible entry instruction contains a grammar error.
remedy: Use a persistent Email address label and an optional example placeholder.
retest: The form contains clear approved wording before and after entry.

explanatory_context.quality_context: The newsletter instruction contains a grammar error and disappears when a value is entered. Correcting the placeholder is useful, but a persistent Email address label gives the field a clear identity throughout the interaction.
explanatory_context.fix_rationale: Use approved wording for the label and keep an optional example distinct from the instruction. This copy repair should be checked separately from whether the subscription service works.
explanatory_context.additional_checks: Inspect the empty and filled field; check its visible and accessible name without relying on placeholder text.
